notes.title: Endless Mode
notes.content:
The latest update for Karate Survivor is here, introducing the highly anticipated Endless Mode! This exciting new feature puts your skills to the test against infinite waves of increasingly challenging enemies, all set in a brand-new arena. Best of all, Endless Mode is available right from the start! Please make sure you have the latest version (1.2.0.277) of the game. 

[b]What’s in Endless Mode? [/b]

[list]
[*] Infinite Waves of Enemies: Face never-ending waves of foes that grow tougher with each round. Test your skills and see how long you can survive! 
[*] New Arena: Battle in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment. Each wave introduces new layouts and object placements to keep combat fresh and unpredictable. 
[*] Camera Movement: The camera is no longer tied to the character, allowing you to freely navigate the arena. 
[*] Leaderboards: Compete online and compare your performance with friends. Prove your worth and claim your spot as a top martial artist in Endless Mode! 
[*] Progression Integration: Bring the skills you’ve unlocked in the main game, like wall runs and obstacle rolls,into the arena. The more abilities you’ve mastered, the better your chances of survival. 
[*] Level Up: Enemies in Endless Mode won’t drop teeth or money, and you’ll receive card upgrades only after defeating each wave. This lets you focus entirely on refining your strategy as the challenge ramps up. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/9986356dd0c10fb04a6cd9578e1d66125c299e5f.png[/img]

Test your endurance, adapt to ever-changing challenges, and climb the leaderboards! Endless Mode is the ultimate test for true martial arts masters. 

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. As always, we’re excited to hear what you think of this update. Stay tuned for even more thrilling content! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: High Dynamic Mode & macOS Version!
notes.content:
The latest update for Karate Survivor is here, bringing you a new gameplay mode! With the introduction of High Dynamic mode, experience the fast-paced street fights at an even more intense speed. Please make sure you have the latest version (1.1.0.237 Windows) or (1.1.0.32 macOS) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/f03b71c2d47e2fd7a6f18fbe9cc7f4f0a6266049.jpg[/img]
High Dynamic mode is an optional feature that increases game speed and its elements by 1.5x for those who crave faster combat. Keep in mind, you’ll need to make strategic decisions faster than ever before. High Dynamic Mode is available from the start of the game and can be enabled or disabled before any run, on any difficulty. 

[b]Changes in High Dynamic Mode: [/b]

[list]
[*] Your character moves faster. 
[*] Attack speed is increased. 
[*] All animations play faster. 
[*] Time passes at an accelerated rate. 
[*] You receive upgrades more quickly. 
[*] Weapons break more quickly. 
[*] Enemies also move faster. 
[/list]
We're also excited to announce that Karate Survivor is now available on macOS!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy this new mode, and as always, keep the feedback coming! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.218
notes.content:
Our latest update for Karate Survivor is here, packed with new features, improvements, and fixes to make Karate Survivor even better. Please make sure you have the latest version (1.0.1.218) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/01f7600f86446503de4a0339685f167bc59c432b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added New Unlock Conditions: We’ve updated and simplified the unlock conditions for many moves to make progression smoother. 
[*] Added Full Keyboard Control: You can now fully control the game using only the keyboard for a more flexible gameplay experience. 
[*] Expanded Starting Moves: There’s now greater variety in the starting moves at the beginning of each run, allowing for a wider range of combos and numeric sequences. 
[*] Addressed issues with incorrect unlocking of specific moves. 
[*] Fixed issues where the Suit boss could freeze under certain conditions. 
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the game to launch the basic tutorial instead of the intended level. 
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the character to freeze in certain situations. 
[*] Fixed an intermittent bug affecting difficulty selection. 
[*] Corrected an issue where push damage was not always recorded accurately. 
[*] Resolved multiple localization issues. 
[*] Various minor fixes for overall smoother gameplay. 
[/list]
Thank you for being part of our journey with Karate Survivor! We hope you enjoy these new updates and improvements. Keep the feedback coming and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback and support on the recent update with difficulty modes! We’re happy to see that the new options allow everyone to enjoy the game at their preferred challenge level.  

We've also noticed that some of you feel the boss fights aren’t challenging enough. To make things better, we’ve made some adjustments to the boss battles, among other changes. Please make sure you have the latest version (1.0.0.208) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/296589b078d6542e9c5437f9e82b7998e27dbaa4.gif[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added new attacks and moves for bosses and adjusted their attack timings to make boss battles more intense. 
[*] Added completion status icons for 'Master' and 'Legend' difficulties. A trophy icon now appears next to each level’s button to help you track progress on these modes. 
[*] Added a powerful new move, the ‘Grand Master’ strike, which unlocks after completing all areas on the ‘Master’ difficulty. 
[*] Increased base damage for all weapon types to help you handle tougher foes. 
[*] Extended full invincibility duration in ‘Golden Lotus’ mode and removed level-up interruptions while active. All accumulated level-ups will apply right after exiting ‘Golden Lotus’ mode. 
[*] Fixed several issues affecting gamepad functionality on certain controllers. 
[*] Fixed multiple minor bugs to improve overall gameplay. 
[/list]
Thank you for being part of our community and sharing your thoughts. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep that feedback coming! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Update with difficulty modes
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you a new update for Katare Survivor, introducing difficulty settings designed for both players looking to relax and fun and those seeking a challenge. Please make sure you have the latest version (1.0.0.199) of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/fe51c33c5a81dbad3cf238b81c8dffe31b62cffb.jpg[/img]
[h3]The game now has 3 difficulty modes:[/h3]

[b]Fighter [/b]– for newcomers [i](available from the start)[/i]. This is the original, base difficulty mode where you can focus on having a good time. 

[b]Master[/b] – for genre veterans [i](available from the start)[/i]. In this mode, enemies will now deal damage on contact, much like other VS-like games. To avoid taking hits while attacking, you’ll need to position yourself much more precisely. Enemies with knives become particularly dangerous, making encounters with them especially risky. To stay on par with your enemies as you progress, you’ll need a strategic approach to upgrades throughout each run, though you likely won’t be able to defeat them all. This difficulty offers a serious challenge for dedicated players! 

[b]Legend[/b] – for legendary martial arts pros and fans of advanced movement [i](unlocks after completing all locations on ‘Master’ difficulty)[/i]. In this mode, enemies not only deal contact damage but also inflict damage through attack animations. Be careful – enemies will show no mercy! This mode demands complete focus, as well as the full use of all your moves and tricks. You’ll need to dodge attacks, strategically save healing items and weapons for later (just remember where you left them 😉), lure enemies into traps, and use mass neutralization zones to control large groups. You’ll also rely on somersaults to escape clusters of foes, slides through tight spaces, and deceptive rolls to throw enemies off your trail. These skills will become essential for survival and present a true challenge for legendary martial arts masters! 

We’re so grateful for the warm reception you’ve given Karate Survivor, your incredible support, and your positive feedback! We’re continuing to improve the game, so stay tuned and keep the feedback coming! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor

notes.title: Demo Recap & Launch Countdown
notes.content:
First off, we want to give a huge thank you to everyone who played the Katare Survivor demo and shared their feedback! Your insights have been essential, and we’ve already launched two updates for the demo to improve balance based on your input. And don’t worry, the balance you experienced isn’t final – we’re actively working to refine it further as we prepare for release! You can still try the demo until Monday if you haven’t yet.

[b]Thanks to you, here’s what we’ve achieved so far: [/b]

[list]
[*] Unique demo players: [b]20,328[/b] 
[*] Median playtime: [b]40[/b] minutes 
[*] New wishlists during the demo: [b]15,000+[/b] 
[/list]
These results are incredible, and we owe it all to you! 

In less than a week, Katare Survivor will be live, packed with even more features!  [b]Here’s what awaits you at launch: [/b]

[list]
[*] 5 unique locations, each with an epic boss fight 
[*] 3 distinct fighting styles to master, each with its own flavor 
[*] 20+ upgrades to enhance your martial arts skills 
[*] Dozens of new strikes for brutal combos against waves of enemies 
[*] Insane new moves like wall flips, rooftop vaulting, and sliding through tight spaces 
[*] New level bonuses like magnets, shurikens, or even a spicy burrito! 
[*] Interactive environments, among which you can zap enemies by electrifying puddles or drop heavy loads on them from construction cranes. 
[*] Wild weapons from wrenches to trash bags 
[*] More destructible objects to smash as you go 
[*] Achievements, full Steam Deck compatibility, and enhanced controller support 
[/list]
We’re also fixing bugs and making balance tweaks to ensure a smoother, action-packed experience at launch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/6ec0fbfd49746985d7a8c106c8f8ec6aefc9f4d0.gif[/img]

Remember to add Katare Survivor to your wishlist if you haven’t already – October 30th is just around the corner!

notes.title: Demo Update with Touch Damage Changes!
notes.content:
We’ve heard your feedback and made an important adjustment to combat mechanics.

Instead of the previous system where the hero took damage every time enemies touched them, now, while your hero is performing a combo, they won’t take damage from enemies! However, once the combo ends and the cooldown begins, you’ll be vulnerable again.

This change was inspired by many of your comments about taking damage on contact during attacks, and we’re excited to see how it impacts your gameplay.

Let us know your thoughts in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3027930/discussions/0/4691154443773746732/]this thread[/url]: do you prefer this new system, or did you like the previous version better? Since this isn’t the final version of the feature, your feedback is crucial to help us refine it!

notes.title: Release date reveal & Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The time has come to announce the release date for Karate Survivor! Get your fists ready because the game is launching on… 

[h3]October 30th, 2024! [/h3]

Inspired by the action movies of the ‘80s, Karate Survivor puts you in the shoes of a martial arts master, fighting off relentless thugs with your fists, feet, and whatever you can find. Smash enemies, chain devastating combos, and turn the environment into your greatest weapon. Every run is a chance to fight smarter, faster, and stronger. 

[previewyoutube=Jvn6zNu1Pmo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you at launch: [/b]
[list]
[*] 5 unique locations, each with its own epic boss. 
[*] 3 distinct fighting styles to master, each with its own flavor. 
[*] Over 20 upgrades to power up your martial arts mastery. 
[*] Dozens of new strikes to unleash brutal combos and wipe out waves of enemies. 
[*] Insane new skills like sliding through tight spaces, flipping off walls, or vaulting across rooftops with a pole – just like an action hero! 
[*] New level bonuses, such as magnets, shurikens, or even a spicy burrito! 
[*] Plenty of destructible objects to smash along the way. 
[*] Dozens of wild weapons, from wrenches and guitars to briefcases and even trash bags. 
[*] Interactive environments, among which you can zap enemies by electrifying puddles or drop heavy loads on them from construction cranes. 
[*] Full Steam Deck compatibility. 
[*] And loads of fights and fun! 
[/list]
With dynamic combat, brutal enemies, and a world full of improvised weapons, Karate Survivor delivers intense street brawls that will test your skills and creativity. The demo is available during Steam Next Fest, starting October 14th – don’t miss your chance to try it out! 

Wishlist Karate Survivor now and get ready to fight:

notes.title: Karate Survivor demo is live!
notes.content:
It hasn’t been long since the last playtest, but thanks to your awesome feedback, we’ve packed this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027940/Karate_Survivor_Demo/]demo[/url] with tons of new features you’ve been asking for – and now you can try them in action! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/881537b95890270cf04e99160a88dd2abacfc8e9.gif[/img]

[b]Here’s what’s new in the demo: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Combo Cooldown Timer.[/b] We’ve added a combo cooldown timer above the main character to help you track when the next attack chain begins, allowing for more strategic planning during fights. For a cleaner interface, this feature (along with others like damage numbers and item highlights) can be toggled off in the settings. 
[*] [b]Unique Attack Animations for All Enemies.[/b] Every enemy now has its own unique attack animations, making combat feel more dynamic and immersive. 
[*] [b]Expanded Attack Directions.[/b] We’ve introduced new “upward” and “downward” attacks, giving you more control over where you strike. This adds depth to combat, letting you target enemies in different zones for a more engaging fighting experience. 
[*] [b]Improved Game Balance.[/b] We’ve adjusted the game’s balance to make the early stages more accessible for new players, while still offering a challenge for seasoned martial arts masters. 
[*] [b]Post-run Stats.[/b] We’ve also added post-run stats that show your run time, level, weapon and skill damage, as well as completed mini-quests. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/a0d87778fbeebcca092e54fc7b54c863a297c039.png[/img]

Your feedback has been crucial in shaping the game, and we can’t wait for you to play the demo and share your thoughts! 

Wishlist Karate Survivor now so you don’t miss the release date reveal at Steam Next Fest and other news: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

For those who prefer a cleaner interface, this feature [i](along with others like damage numbers and item highlights)[/i] can be toggled off in the settings. 
[*][b] Attack Animations for All Enemies.[/b] Every enemy will have its own unique attack animations, making combat feel more dynamic and immersive. 
[*][b] Expanded Attack Directions.[/b] We’re introducing new “upward” and “downward” attacks, giving you more control over where you strike. This adds greater depth to combat, allowing you to target enemies in different zones for a more dynamic fighting experience. 
[*][b]Improved Game Balance.[/b] We’ve adjusted the game’s balance to make the early stages more accessible for new players, while still offering a challenge for seasoned martial arts masters.

The full release is coming very soon – be sure to wishlist and follow Karate Survivor to stay updated! Plus, you’ll get a chance to experience these updates with an upcoming demo in early October.
